name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06
notes: The watch: ESP32-S3R8 (8 MB octal PSRAM) in a wrist form factor with a 410x502 CO5300 AMOLED on QSPI, FT3168 capacitive touch, QMI8658C 6-axis IMU, PCF85063ATL RTC and an AXP2101 PMIC, all sharing one I2C bus on SDA=15/SCL=14. Audio is the same ES8311-out/ES7210-in pair as the AUDIO-Board, so codec_init.cpp already knows the chip — but the pins differ and the NS4150B amp enable is a direct GPIO (46) here rather than living behind an I/O expander, which makes the speaker one pin away instead of an I2C transaction. Two things this board has that no earlier profile did: a screen, and a power management chip. The AXP2101 gates rails, so a build that assumes peripherals are powered at boot may find the codec silent for reasons that are not the codec's; bring the PMIC up before blaming the audio path. The display is deliberately absent from this manifest — the firmware has no display layer yet, and inventing schema for one before the code exists would be a guess.

audio_in.notes: Dual digital microphone array sharing the ES8311's MCLK/BCLK/LRCK. Not yet driven by the firmware; AudioInput nodes produce silence on this board for now, exactly as on the AUDIO-Board.
